narr: A complex of thunderstorms moved east across parts of southern Illinois through the morning. Training of heavy rain resulted in widespread 2 to 4 inches of rainfall along the Interstate 64 corridor. The persistent thunderstorms were focused along a stalled elevated warm front across the mid Mississippi Valley. Strong convergence in the 925 to 850 mb layer was oriented generally parallel to the mean storm movement. Instability of at least 500-1500 J/kg just south of the training storms supported high rainfall rates.
ev: Street flooding was reported by the public west of Mount Vernon. Between 3 and 4 inches of rain was measured at several sites in western and central Jefferson County.
